07b8f05e673991bba141.en: To divide by a 2-digit number, take away chunks of the divisor.
07b8f05e673991bba141.id: Untuk membagi dengan bilangan 2 angka, kurangi bertahap dengan kelipatan pembaginya.

37e7cdc66cee8e40c3b3.en: Write some easy multiples of 18 first.
37e7cdc66cee8e40c3b3.id: Tulis dulu beberapa kelipatan 18 yang mudah.

6cdc6a55fb642f8a04cf.en: Take away 50 lots of 18, then 4 lots of 18.

86265b70da9d97674764.en: A remainder can be written as a whole number, a fraction or a decimal.
86265b70da9d97674764.id: Sisa bisa ditulis sebagai bilangan bulat, pecahan, atau desimal.

cf0b0de9895ec61b96c2.en: Choose the form that fits the problem. Money and measures often need a decimal.
cf0b0de9895ec61b96c2.id: Pilih bentuk yang cocok dengan soalnya. Uang dan ukuran sering memerlukan desimal.

8db1520a462ecd2e351b.en: 52 × 7 = 364, which leaves 16 people. They need another coach, so 8 coaches are needed.
8db1520a462ecd2e351b.id: 52 × 7 = 364, jadi masih ada 16 orang. Mereka perlu satu bus lagi, jadi diperlukan 8 bus.

a2e3f4a035fbd9903b3d.en: 24 × 60 = 1,440 and 1,512 − 1,440 = 72, which is 3 more 24s. So 63 boxes.
a2e3f4a035fbd9903b3d.id: 24 × 60 = 1,440 dan 1,512 − 1,440 = 72, yaitu 3 kali 24 lagi. Jadi 63 kotak.

addc7eaa458fb31a798e.en: 345 ÷ 12 = 28 remainder 9, and 9 ÷ 12 = 0.75. Each piece is 28.75 cm.
addc7eaa458fb31a798e.id: 345 ÷ 12 = 28 sisa 9, dan 9 ÷ 12 = 0.75. Panjang setiap potongan 28.75 cm.

116f9bacd5c1c16111af.en: 1,000 ÷ 45 is 22 remainder 10. The remaining 10 pupils need one more bus, so 23 buses are needed.
116f9bacd5c1c16111af.id: 1,000 ÷ 45 adalah 22 sisa 10. Sisa 10 murid itu perlu satu bus lagi, jadi diperlukan 23 bus.

0e4c381e962af0ea684d.en: 15 × 16 = 240, so the remainder is 10. A remainder of 20 is bigger than 15, which is impossible.
0e4c381e962af0ea684d.id: 15 × 16 = 240, jadi sisanya 10. Sisa 20 lebih besar daripada 15, dan itu tidak mungkin.
